mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_TYPE , BOARD_NUM , BOARD_TITLE , BOARD_COMMENT FROM ( SELECT BOARD_TYPE , BOARD_NUM , BOARD_TITLE , BOARD_COMMENT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY CASE WHEN BOARD_TYPE IN ('EI','IE') THEN 1 WHEN BOARD_TYPE IN ('NS','SN') THEN 2 WHEN BOARD_TYPE IN ('FT','TF') THEN 3 ELSE 4 END , BOARD_NUM , BOARD_TYPE) AS NUMROW FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_TYPE IN ('EI','IE','NS','SN','FT','TF','JP','PJ') ) WHERE NUMROW BETWEEN (#{pageNo}-1)*#{pageSize} + 1 AND (#{pageNo})*#{pageSize} ORDER BY NUMROW
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_TYPE IN ('EI','IE','NS','SN','FT','TF','JP','PJ')
